prompt:
Image format: a vertical portrait-orientation photograph, 4:5 aspect ratio, taller than it is wide.

A full-body photograph in a vast stone courtyard of the Forbidden City with a standard-height palace gate, marble steps with waist-high balustrades, empty of visitors, bright and evenly lit, shadows soft, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus, empty of any people other than the subjects, no readable signs or text anywhere, no props or statues made of the same material as them, NO dark background NO black void, TWO people standing side by side with generous spacing so every figure reads clearly and nobody's arms cross a neighbour, the camera set back so both are visible from head to toe, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/8, in natural sunlight, sharp focus on every figure, realistic photographic grain — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

LEFT: ONE real adult Ethiopian woman, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, smooth warm-brown skin, a bold thick black liner drawn around the whole eye and winged slightly at the outer corner, warm gold and brown eyeshadow, strongly defined softly arched brows, long lashes, large dark eyes with bright real catchlights, a natural warm rose-brown lip with a soft gloss, a serene, dignified expression, soft pastel-mint-green hair styled in an intricate fishtail braid, real living eyes, wearing a different earring on each ear: on one ear a large rose-gold hoop carrying five heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on rose-gold chains of different lengths (a bronze chunky hexagonal nut-shaped weight with a round hole through the centre, a tin cube-shaped block, a silver hammer head, a silver barrel-shaped weight, a tin miniature anvil), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and on the other ear a single long brass chain ending in one large faceted topaz drop with a heavy rough copper a barrel-shaped weight hanging at its end, and two to three gold anklets. Extremely long almond nails, glitter finish studded with crystals.
LEFT Physique: waist cinched to absolute impossible minimum, hips AND bust simultaneously flaring to absolute maximum, thighs pressing together, every curve maximized at once Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.
LEFT Body Art: Her body carries dragon scales (large thick armor-plate scales, each one substantial and sharply faceted), BLAZING DEEP EMERALD scale formations, VIVID JADE scale-edge detail, every scale catching its own glint and casting its own small shadow. It is fused to her own living skin and flexes slightly over every bulge, with no fabric, seam or garment anywhere. It covers her whole body with no bare skin left anywhere below the jaw: shoulders, upper arms, forearms, backs of her hands, sides, back, rear, lower belly, knees, calves and the tops of her feet. Her face is left bare and the material fades out at the neck with no hard line.
LEFT Pose: both hands on her hips, elbows out.
LEFT Footwear: Extreme cobalt-blue platform thigh-skimming boots, the platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone, at least three times the thickness of an ordinary heel.

RIGHT: ONE real adult Korean man in his late 20s, his face exactly the same tone as his body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, a youthful idol face with a small V-line jaw, bright expressive eyes and a straight nose, clean-shaven, light smoky eyeliner and glossy skin, luminous porcelain skin, a bright open smile showing his teeth, natural soft black hair styled in countless fine micro braids, real living eyes, wearing a different earring on each ear: on one ear a single long gold chain ending in one large faceted emerald drop, and on the other ear a large brass hoop carrying two heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on brass chains of different lengths (a gold cube-shaped block, a silver square-sided cowbell), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and seven to ten heavily stacked platinum hair ornaments. Extremely long stiletto nails, glitter finish studded with crystals.
RIGHT Physique: A very tall, slim, long-limbed man with a runway build. Straight shoulders, a flat lean chest, a flat defined stomach, slender strong arms and very long legs, lightly muscled and elegant, with visible collarbones and a narrow waist. His head stays in correct proportion to his long frame. His arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.
RIGHT Body Art: His body carries snake scales (diamond-shaped angular scales aligned in neat overlapping rows), BLAZING PALE GOLD scale formations, VIVID IVORY WHITE scale-edge detail, every scale catching its own glint and casting its own small shadow. It is fused to his own living skin and flexes slightly over every bulge, with no fabric, seam or garment anywhere. It covers his whole body with no bare skin left anywhere below the jaw: shoulders, upper arms, forearms, backs of his hands, sides, back, rear, lower belly, knees, calves and the tops of his feet. His face is left bare and the material fades out at the neck with no hard line.
RIGHT Pose: three-quarter angle, one hand on his hip.
RIGHT Footwear: Extreme hot-pink plain stiletto pumps with a razor-thin tapered heel a full forty inches tall and a twelve-inch hidden front platform.

Skin (everyone): Real photographic skin — visible pores and fine grain, a taut surface with natural creases and shadow only where the flesh and muscle fold. No smooth illustration finish, no plastic CG sheen.

Background & Lighting: each material catching the sunlight in sharp glints, the sunlight carving every fold, curve and muscle. Vertical 4:5 portrait-orientation full-body photograph, taller than it is wide, all faces toward the camera.
